mechanism: Foscarnet can cause significant electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) and renal impairment, which may exacerbate niacin-induced hyperglycemia and metabolic effects; both agents can contribute to glucose metabolism dysregulation.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and glucose levels closely during concurrent use; adjust niacin dosing if renal function declines; consider alternative antivirals if metabolic complications arise.
